description.value:
Duration constant

Your Feral Bond gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level at the start of each encounter. These are lost before its own Hit Points and do not return until the next encounter begins.

cinderfall.incomplete: A recurring temp-HP grant to a *different* actor. Confirmed no such cross-actor pattern exists: grep -rl "TempHP" pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/ranger/ pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/ class-features/ | grep -i companion returns zero hits. This effect buffs, protects, or grants actions to the Feral Bond (the companion beast) from the holder's own card. No rule-element selector in pf2e-source lets one actor's item grant a stat bonus, temp HP, an extra action, or a shared sense to a different actor's sheet -- confirmed by spot-checking real pf2e's own fully-built Animal Companion subsystem (Ranger/Druid), where virtually every companion-buff/companion-action-economy feat ships with rules: [] too.
